en: The postcard features a black and white photograph of a large orchestra performing outdoors. The members are dressed formally and seated behind a trimmed hedge, with the conductor prominently positioned at the center. Above the orchestra, a sign reads 'Konzertführer.' On the reverse, there is a museum stamp from 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont,' and the photographer's attribution is given as H. Schlitzberger, Bad Pyrmont. The card has the appearance of early-to-mid 20th-century German postcards.
